summary.text: Jack Johnson is a Republican state senator from Franklin who represents Tennessee Senate District 27 (Williamson County), serves as Senate Republican Leader and Majority Leader, and is listed as the incumbent candidate in the 2026 election.
He is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Jack Johnson was born on July 25, 1968, in Amarillo, Texas, and has a wife, Deanna, and three children.
He holds a B.S. in education from Texas State University and lists his profession as small business owner.
Johnson has been a member of the Senate from the 105th through the 114th General Assemblies and is the Republican Leader.
He serves on the Senate Commerce and Labor, Finance, Ways and Means, Calendar and Ethics committees.
He is a member of the Metro Nashville Airport Authority Board of Commissioners and of the State Capitol Commission.
